children: Australian private-sector business investment surged 12% on quarter in 3Q, the largest quarterly gain since a 2011 mining boom and far above the 4.3% consensus. The surge was driven by a 23% jump in equipment, plant and machinery investment from AI-related spending. Josh Williamson, chief economist at Citi, says domestic demand could accelerate by up to 1.5% in 3Q, taking yearly growth to a "too hot" 3.3%. With demand running above potential and the AI boom competing for land, labor and capital, Williamson sees the RBA holding the official cash rate at 4.85%, with upward risk of another hike.
